rationale: Motor vehicle collision with total loss and bodily injury to the policyholder resulting from the impact.
claim_summary: Rear-end collision on Route 9 at 8:15 AM yesterday at a red light. Policyholder's vehicle is totaled (trunk crushed into back seat); other driver at fault per police report. Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. High-priority case requiring vehicle appraisal and injury assessment against coverage limit of $100k with $750 deductible.

case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled — entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.other_driver_at_fault: other driver at 35 mph, no braking, police report filed
